rust_summary: block entity NBT for server mods: `native_set_block_entity` and `native_block_entity_nbt`, and `NativeBlockEdit::block_entities` for bulk edits.
doc_summary: `native_set_block_entity(dimension, pos, nbt)` loads SNBT into the block entity at `pos` of the level being ticked as `/setblock ... {nbt}` does (false, changing nothing, when there is no block entity there or the `id` given is another type), `native_block_entity_nbt(dimension, pos)` reads its saved NBT as SNBT, and `NativeBlockEdit::block_entities` gives a bulk edit block entity data per position, loaded after the runs. Bundles need "hooks": @API:edit_blocks_nbt@.
